name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix
description: Single-shot Fortinet Mantis bug → fix → MR pipeline. User provides a bug id + base branch; pipeline fetches Mantis context, has Claude propose a minimal fix per user_prompt focus, opens a GitLab MR via glab, notifies assignee + reporter on Teams. Copy of mantis-bug-fix-and-mr with user_prompt and baked-in defaults for MR/Teams templates.
author: forge
